resources.string: Verify SSH credentials before launching local apps. Enable to choose a container. The server must be that container.
Launch verification for %1$s · %2$s. When enabled, every launch verifies the SSH host, container identity and saved credentials.
Choose the container for this connection. Once verification succeeds, apps launch as %1$s. If the host, account or credentials cannot be verified, launch stops.
First log in to this SSH connection and confirm its current host fingerprint, then enable launch verification.
Could not read this container’s SSH identity. Check its account, Python 3 and OpenSSH server configuration.
The SSH server or logged-in user does not match the selected container account. Launch was stopped.
SSH connection or authentication failed. Check the server and saved credentials. Launch was stopped.
Could not remove the temporary container verification file. Launch was stopped.
Turn off launch verification before changing this credential’s container.
